source: Written for geography/y1 lesson 2 (Blank UK map (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 2: The four countries of the UK and their capitals. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

blocks.text: Colour the four countries: England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Draw a star where you live.

panels.title: Four countries, one kingdom
points: Together they are the United Kingdom

panels.title: Seas all around
points: Atlantic Ocean to the north and west

keywords.def: a land with its own name and people
the most important city of a country
England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland together
a big area of salty water
land with water all around it

questions.q: Which sea is to the east of the UK?
Core: On the blank UK map, write the four countries and their capitals.
questions.a: England: London; Scotland: Edinburgh; Wales: Cardiff; Northern Ireland: Belfast

questions.q: Extend: Label two seas on the map.
questions.a: For example: North Sea and Irish Sea

questions.q: Stretch: Which country is the biggest?

questions.a: B) Cardiff. Cardiff is in Wales; Edinburgh is in Scotland and Belfast is in Northern Ireland.

questions.q: The UK has how many countries?
Big question: what makes the four countries one UK?
questions.a: They are joined together as one kingdom, with one government in London
